markers.cm: 01_1 · The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the 1760s.
01_2 · Machines and factories changed how things were made.
02_1 · Before we read the source, here are four hard words.

04_1 · Documentary one shows the blessing side.
04_2 · Cloth became cheap, and railways moved goods and people fast.
05_1 · Documentary two shows the other side.
05_2 · Owners grew rich, while children worked 16 hours.
05_3 · And factory smoke turned city skies black.
